priorSnapshots.scope: Actual public pages in fresh Playwright contexts, source-bundled same-world UI and native browser source-link clicks. Not an installed-extension toolbar/activeTab test, business completion or human usability evidence.
conditions: No input entry, search submission, login, authentication, payment, application submission or download activation.
Only explicit public navigation tasks may click the original matching HTTP(S) anchor. Locate-only tasks stop at original focus and visible source guidance.
Presentation popup dismissal is limited to explicit close/do-not-show controls and recorded per page.
Fixture IDs are used only to derive descriptors offline. No data-eval-id is added to actual pages.
Classification uses the frozen in-memory source bundle. No fixture, expected data or classifier rule is changed by this script.

scope: Actual public pages in fresh Playwright contexts, source-bundled UI in a CDP-created isolated world and native browser source-link clicks. Not an installed-extension toolbar/activeTab test, business completion or human usability evidence.
conditions: No input entry, search submission, login, authentication, payment, application submission or download activation.
Only explicit public navigation tasks may click the original matching HTTP(S) anchor. Locate-only tasks stop at original focus and visible source guidance.
Presentation popup dismissal is limited to explicit close/do-not-show controls and recorded per page.
Fixture IDs are used only to derive descriptors offline. No data-eval-id is added to actual pages.
Classification uses the frozen in-memory source bundle. No fixture, expected data or classifier rule is changed by this script.
CDP isolated-world evaluation avoids the observed main-world Playwright evaluation-helper interaction on the library site; this is not an extension installation test.
Native input mapping permits exact fixed id plus placeholder (or exact placeholder without fixture id) when a fuller actual-page linked label differs from the reduced fixture.

During task activation, navigation requests with non-GET/HEAD methods or authentication-start paths are blocked. Public target anchors are checked against the exact known href before native mouse activation.

acceptance: NOT_MET: actual public tasks reached 7 of 15; all 15 actual controls were matched, and 8 task controls were not recommended.

harnessCorrections.scope: Evaluation realm, not product or fixture change
harnessCorrections.observation: On the library public site, Playwright main-world evaluate returned undefined for objects and arrays, while direct CDP Runtime.evaluate returned 42 and the public document title; a CDP-created isolated world returned the expected object and public control count.
harnessCorrections.correction: Use a CDP-created isolated world consistently for the source bundle and descriptor inspection on all sites. No extension installation or activeTab claim is made.

harnessCorrections.scope: Reduced-fixture descriptor matching, not expected-data change
harnessCorrections.observation: The actual SMU notice search input had the same fixed id and placeholder but a richer linked label than the reduced fixture.
harnessCorrections.correction: Allow native input fixed id plus exact placeholder, or exact placeholder when fixture id is absent. Preserve original expected task/source IDs.

harnessCorrections.scope: Original public menu flow, not copied URL fallback
harnessCorrections.observation: Focusing the SMU academic menu changed its original href to #a and revealed a visible child academic-calendar link.
harnessCorrections.correction: Record that focus mutation and follow only the visible original child link under the recommended original menu whose HTTP(S) href exactly matches the known public task destination. No address-bar jump or copied URL navigation.

harnessCorrections.observation: The initial snapshot used allDatasetTasksExecuted for page attempts, while passed and allPassed separately showed failures.
harnessCorrections.correction: Current report uses allDatasetTasksAttempted. Earlier raw snapshots retain their original fields and are not claims that all tasks completed.
